events.title: Spore bloom
events.warning: Spore counts in the hollows are rising. In five days the forest will bloom.
events.text: The forest is blooming. A yellow haze drifts over the colony, and the spores settle in air intakes and greenhouses. Without protection we lose the harvest, and the air in the housing grows heavy.

options.label: Run the filters at full
options.description: The filter module keeps the air clean in housing and greenhouses. Costs new filter bags. The harvest is saved.
options.result: The filters hummed for nine days. When the haze lifted, the air was still clean and the greenhouses stood green.

options.label: Seal the greenhouses
options.description: Build extra airlocks and keep the greenhouses separate. The food is saved, but the air in the housing turns bad for a week or so.
options.result: The airlocks kept the spores out of the greenhouses. In the housing, people coughed for a week.

options.label: Shut down and wait
options.description: Shut the air intakes and live off stores until the bloom is over. It costs nothing now, but the harvest is lost.
options.result: The colony held its breath for ten days. The harvest rotted, but everyone made it through.

events.title: Dust storm
events.warning: A brown front stands 300 kilometers to the west. It will reach us in three days.
events.text: The sky turns brown at midday. Dust settles on the panels layer by layer, and power falls hour by hour. The storm may last two weeks.

options.label: Run on batteries
options.description: Fold the panels and live on stored power. The panels are spared, but the reserve drains.
options.result: The panels lay sheltered while the batteries carried the colony. The day after the storm, everything ran again.

options.label: Send out cleaning crews
options.description: Drones and workshop keep the panels clean around the clock. Costs spare parts, but power holds.
options.result: The drones brushed the panels every four hours. Power dipped, but it never failed.

options.label: Wait out the storm
options.description: Do nothing and save power. Free now, but the dust wears on everything, and the panels yield less for a long time.
options.result: When the storm settled, the dust lay a hand's breadth thick. It took two weeks to get the panels clean.

events.title: The deep cold
events.warning: The temperature is falling faster than forecast. In six days the coldest period of the year arrives.
events.text: The cold comes in waves. The pipes creak, and the water in the lines begins to freeze. Housing uses twice the usual heat, and the night is long.

options.label: Pipe in geothermal heat
options.description: Heat from below ground is pumped straight into housing. Stable, but the generator wears.
options.result: The floors were warm all winter. The generator was loud, but it held.

options.label: Turn up the heating modules
options.description: The heating modules run at full power. Costs power from the reserve and a few spare parts.
options.result: The heating modules glowed around the clock. The reserve fell, but no one froze.

options.label: Gather everyone in the Ark
options.description: Everyone moves into the Ark's core, kept warm by emergency power. Free, but the colony stands still, and dependence on the Ark grows.
options.result: For three weeks everyone lived crowded together in the Ark's corridors. It was cramped. It was warm.
